title: TypeSafe clears 140,000 users off the waitlist in 36 hours
summary: After launch-day demand, TypeSafe reported moving 140k signups off the waitlist within roughly a day and a half, while asking new users to keep using the Vercel AI Gateway in the meantime. Production reports cited include a -71% cost and -90% wall-time reduction on a dispatch workflow, and 1,018 research papers classified for $0.08 at 256ms median latency.
comment_en: The 140k waitlist clearance matters less than the cited benchmarks—71% cost and 90% wall-time cuts suggest Jev's typed decisions could replace brittle prompt chains, though single-vendor numbers warrant independent replication.
comment_zh: 14万候补用户清理速度不如其引用的基准数据重要——成本降低71%、实际耗时缩短90%表明Jev的类型化决策可能取代脆弱的提示链，但单一厂商数据仍需独立复现验证。

title: Cloudflare, OpenRouter and LangChain add Jev on day one

title: Launch: TypeSafe introduces System One Models and Jev
summary: TypeSafe AI launches Jev, a model that returns typed decisions (Choice, Score, Noul) with calibrated probabilities instead of generating text. Headline claims: 193.6x faster and 444.6x cheaper than frontier LLMs on System One workflows, $0.042 per 1M input tokens with output unmetered, and 0% schema/type errors by construction.
comment_en: Jev's promise of structural zero type errors matters most for pipelines where parsing failures silently corrupt downstream logic, but those 193x speed and 444x cost claims deserve independent replication before teams rebuild around them.
comment_zh: Jev 宣称的结构性零类型错误，对解析失败会悄悄污染下游逻辑的流水线最有价值；但 193 倍速度和 444 倍成本的说法值得独立复现，团队再据此重构才稳妥。
